A Mercedes van turned into a home on wheels! In this episode of our USA road trip, I take you inside Sunty Bhai’s ₹1 crore camper van and show you the home he built himself.
Sunty Bhai bought this Mercedes second-hand and spent around nine months converting it into a camper. From an ordinary van to a travelling home, this build took patience, planning and plenty of hard work.
